points.description: Forms the augmented third-order model with the integral state ξ included (state [θ, θ̇, ξ]), substituting the control law into the plant to get θ̈ = −(c+bk1)θ − (a+bk2)θ̇ + bK_I ξ and ξ̇ = r − θ (equivalently the A_cl matrix [[0,1,0],[−(c+bk1),−(a+bk2),bK_I],[−1,0,0]]). Either sign convention (ξ̇ = θ − r with −K_Iξ) is acceptable if used consistently.
Correct symbolic closed-loop characteristic polynomial s³ + (a+bk2)s² + (c+bk1)s + bK_I.
Correct desired polynomial from poles −4 and −2±2j: (s+4)(s²+4s+8) = s³ + 8s² + 24s + 32.

Matches coefficients with a=2, b=1, c=6 to get all three gains: k1 = 18, k2 = 6, K_I = 32. (If the student uses ξ̇ = r − θ with −K_Iξ and gets K_I = −32, full credit provided the convention is stated and the algebra is consistent.)

levels.says: Two of the three gains correct, or all three correct from matching coefficients but with one arithmetic slip carried from an earlier error.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the correct augmented model, the symbolic polynomial, the desired polynomial, and all three gains (k1=18, k2=6, K_I=32). A different but consistent sign convention for ξ and K_I is accepted in full. Earlier errors lose only the later dependent steps; a wrong gain from a correct method still keeps the method points.
rubric.answer_key: Augmented state x=[θ θ̇ ξ]ᵀ, ξ̇=r−θ. With u=−k1θ−k2θ̇+K_Iξ: θ̈ = −(c+bk1)θ − (a+bk2)θ̇ + bK_Iξ. A_cl=[[0,1,0],[−(c+bk1),−(a+bk2),bK_I],[−1,0,0]]. det(sI−A_cl)= s³+(a+bk2)s²+(c+bk1)s+bK_I. Desired: (s+4)(s²+4s+8)=s³+8s²+24s+32. Match with a=2,b=1,c=6: 2+k2=8 → k2=6; 6+k1=24 → k1=18; K_I=32.
